title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
Implemented globally by Trócaire’s Global Hub on Partnership and Localisation, the ICSP programme works towards fulfilling Trócaire's commitment to localisation, while also inspiring sectoral transformation in solidarity with local actors. This objective focuses on the provision of more tailored and responsive capacity strengthening to local and national partners. Key activities include the revision/development of new capacity strengthening tools and training materials for Trócaire staff; roll out of the revised capacity strengthening approach at country level; and pilot initiatives at country level to support specific and contextual capacity strengthening needs. The principal focus of this outcome is:
Partnership and localisation; with a focus on Women Centred Organisations
Providing institutional capacity building and support to partners
